name: CRS Status
definition: Common Reporting Standard (CRS) status and the status source of the investor.

CRSStatus.name: CRS Status
CRSStatus.definition: Common Reporting Standard (CRS) status of the investor.

ExceptionalReportingCountry.name: Exceptional Reporting Country
ExceptionalReportingCountry.definition: Reporting country for the CRS status when there is an exception at the country level.

CRSSourceStatus.name: CRS Source Status
CRSSourceStatus.definition: Source of the Common Reporting Standard (CRS) status expressed as a code.

CRSReportingDate.name: CRS Reporting Date
CRSReportingDate.definition: Date provided by the account owner to inform the account servicer of the date on which the holdings must be reported before the account is subsequently closed.

InvestmentAccountParty.name: Investment Account Party
InvestmentAccountParty.definition: Common Reporting Standard (CRS) status linked to an investment account and played by a party in that context.
